extracted.name: Basil Vinaigrette
extracted.description: This basil vinaigrette made with freshly chopped basil, olive oil, apple cider vinegar, honey, and garlic is a delicious dressing for summer salads.
instruction_lines: Whisk olive oil, apple cider vinegar, honey, basil, and garlic together in a bowl until well combined.
Pour over or toss with your favorite salad to serve.
